sources.entry: Cue - IDE-style autocomplete for commands, options, Git branches, and files in zsh on Apple Terminal and VS Code’s integrated terminal. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/8starlabs/cue) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Cue
summary.one_liner: Cue is a free, open-source tool that shows IDE-style autocomplete suggestions for commands, options, Git branches, and file paths as you type in zsh on Apple Terminal and VS Code's integrated terminal.
use_cases: Autocomplete git commands and branch names while typing
Discover command options and arguments without reading man pages
Insert file and folder paths in the terminal without pressing Tab
Get command completions inside VS Code's integrated terminal
summary.what_it_does: Cue displays suggestions for commands, subcommands, options, and arguments as you type in the terminal, with no Tab press needed. It suggests Git commands and branch names, plus files and folders with file-type icons and contextual descriptions. It uses open-source Fig command specs for command coverage. You navigate suggestions with arrow keys, insert with Enter or Tab, and dismiss with Esc.
notable: Suggestions appear as you type, without pressing Tab
Uses open-source Fig command specs and shows Fig-style icons
File-type icons for common formats such as JavaScript, JSON, TypeScript, and Next.js config files
Works in both Apple Terminal and VS Code's integrated terminal
caveats: Supports zsh only, as named on the page
Works only in Apple Terminal and VS Code's integrated terminal, as listed
Several file-type icons (e.g., CSS, HTML, Python, Rust) are not mapped to file types, per the page
